# Extended image: pi-sandbox with wiki and learning extensions.
#
# Build (directory builds default to pi-sandbox:base):
#   docker build -f Dockerfile.pi.wiki -t pi-sandbox:wiki .
#   docker build --build-arg BASE_IMAGE=pi-sandbox:base -f Dockerfile.pi.wiki -t pi-sandbox:wiki .

ARG BASE_IMAGE=pi-sandbox:base
FROM ${BASE_IMAGE}

RUN mkdir -p /root/.pi/agent/npm \
  && cd /root/.pi/agent/npm \
  && npm install --legacy-peer-deps opencode-engram-learning@latest pi-llm-wiki@latest

# Add extensions to settings.json packages array
RUN node -e "\
  const s = JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/root/.pi/agent/settings.json','utf8')); \
  if (!s.packages.includes('npm:opencode-engram-learning')) { s.packages.push('npm:opencode-engram-learning'); }\
  if (!s.packages.includes('npm:pi-llm-wiki')) { s.packages.push('npm:pi-llm-wiki'); }\
  require('fs').writeFileSync('/root/.pi/agent/settings.json', JSON.stringify(s, null, 2) + '\\n');\
"
